name: Break Vector
description: Splits a Vector into its three float components (X, Y, Z). Used to read or modify a single axis of a vector value.

inputs.name: V
inputs.description: Vector to decompose. Connect the output of any node that returns a Vector (e.g. Get Actor Location, Get Velocity, Make Vector).

outputs.name: X
outputs.description: Horizontal component. Connect to math nodes, float variables, or comparison nodes.

outputs.name: Y
outputs.description: Depth component. Connect to math nodes, float variables, or comparison nodes.

outputs.name: Z
outputs.description: Vertical component. Connect to math nodes, float variables, or comparison nodes.
